entities.name: Barrin Grevik
entities.description: A self-satisfied market shopkeeper on Tin Street whose family have been market people for generations.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mage who is tracing Azorius waypoints along the Implicit Maze and wipes Barrin's memory.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A market street in Ravnica's Tenth District where Barrin's shop stands.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: A district of Ravnica, shown to Barrin as a glowing model.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A maze of ancient Azorius waypoints that Jace must run in the right sequence to stop the guilds destroying one another.

entities.name: Azorius waypoint
entities.description: The etched cornerstone by Barrin's shop, one of the points along the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A guild Barrin suspects Jace of belonging to; Jace says the Dimir are forcing his hand.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild that left the waypoints and whose old legislative archives sit at the end of the line.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild whose goblin ambushes Barrin in the alley.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A guild whose wojek police and pendrek weapon Barrin knows.

entities.name: Estovar
entities.description: Barrin's great uncle, who theorized the Azorius put the stone there after the first Guildpact.

events.summary: Barrin challenges the hooded man examining the cornerstone and is compelled to tell him everything he knows about it.
events.quote: he found himself talking all about the history of the stone

events.summary: Barrin decides the stranger is a Dimir and resolves to follow him.
events.quote: He's a Dimir, Nila. I just know it.

events.summary: Barrin follows the hooded man into an alley.
events.quote: Barrin followed the hooded figure at a distance.

events.summary: A Rakdos goblin ambushes Barrin in the alley and flees when he brandishes his pendrek.
events.quote: Barrin brandished his pendrek and the goblin scampered off into the dark, cackling obscenities.

events.summary: Barrin finds the hooded stranger in a basement studying a glowing model of the Tenth District.
events.quote: to reveal the hooded stranger staring at a ghostlike image of the Tenth District

events.summary: Jace explains that the cornerstone is an Azorius waypoint on the Implicit Maze, which he must run to stop the guilds destroying each other.
events.quote: The cornerstone by your shop is actually an Azorius waypoint

events.summary: Jace gives his name and erases Barrin's memory of the encounter.
events.quote: And you are not going to remember a single moment of this, my foolish friend.

events.summary: Barrin wakes the next day with no memory and blames drinking bumbat.

relations.quote: His wife, Nila, noticed that Barrin had "that look" in his eyes

relations.note: The Dimir force Jace to act fast.
relations.quote: the Dimir are forcing my hand to act fast
the cornerstone with the odd etching that marked the edge of his shop
